build_api_create_reload_request: build an ApiCreateReloadRequest TypedDict with filepath, contents, and optional reloadId for initiating a hot reload
build_api_get_reload_request: build an ApiGetReloadRequest TypedDict with a reloadId string to query reload event stream data
build_api_get_status_request: build an ApiGetStatusRequest TypedDict with a revision string to check reloading status and uncommitted files
build_api_fetch_contents_request: build an ApiFetchContentsRequest TypedDict with a filepath string to fetch file contents from the repository
build_reload_operation_object: build a ReloadOperationObject TypedDict with kind, region, objectType, and objectName for tracking code changes
